benchmark: Neuron metadata guard open-set image-classification diagnostic

protocol.features: L2-normalized flattened pixels; class score is mean top-3 cosine similarities
protocol.guard_source: Guard policy executed from the implementation in Untitled36.ipynb (metadata guard functions and thresholds)
protocol.cnn: two-convolution CPU CNN, trained 18 epochs on the same known-class training split; no unknown-rejection head
protocol.limitation: Controlled small-image guard-policy test. Not a FaceNet embedding evaluation or a test of the full face-recognition pipeline.

interpretation: On this fixed small-digit test, the guard-enabled exemplar classifier scores 0.83 percentage points higher on known-class end-to-end accuracy than the small CNN and rejects 59.09% of held-out unknowns. The unguarded exemplar classifier has the highest known-only accuracy, but accepts all held-out unknowns. These results do not establish superiority on natural images or face recognition.
